content: KRL: revoke by serial/range/bitmap and key id per CA (empty CA = all CAs), explicit keys, sha1/sha256 fingerprints. OpenSSH >=9.4 refuses KRLs containing embedded signatures; sign out-of-band with SSHSIG. sshd: if RevokedKeys file unreadable, pubkey auth refused for all users. sshd checks both the key and the cert's CA signature key against RevokedKeys (auth2-pubkey.c), so a CA key can be revoked via KRL. sshd logs 'ID <keyid> (serial N) CA <type> <fp>' on accept. stripe/krl archived Apr 2025.
